entries.name: 50onPaletteServer
entries.note: Built 2026-10-17: the 50-on chart is the Kana tab of Edit > Emoji & Symbols (character_viewer.rs). The tab draws gojuon::layout, a point hits the kana under it with gojuon::cell_at, and a pick types the kana into the Search field or copies it; typing a romaji word in the panel finds its kana. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: the palette view is the Kana tab of the Emoji & Symbols panel, drawn with gojuon::layout and hit with gojuon::cell_at; the checks run the chart model and the panel (geometry, hits, search)
